en: A black and white photograph showing a formal gathering. In the foreground, a man in a suit and hat is receiving a bouquet of flowers from a woman in traditional folk dress, adorned with jewelry and a headscarf. Several men, also dressed formally (some with rosettes pinned to their chests), surround them, smiling or observing the exchange. The setting appears to be public and ceremonial.
